title: AEW coordination seal
description: F9-A (ADR-0017 D7; plan v4 D-16, D-38): .aew/work/<T>/coordination/<INV>.seal-<sha12>.yaml, written once, immutable and content-addressed, by the commit that ends the invocation, before that commit, and referenced from the unit's pointer by path and hash. It pins the thread's bytes as sealed, so a full history verification covers them; the thread accepts nothing afterwards.

closed_rev.description: The control revision of the commit that ended the invocation.

thread.description: The thread file exactly as sealed: its path under .aew, the sha256 of all its bytes, and their number.

head.description: The chain hash after the last verified line (the genesis hash when none verified).

messages.description: The number of messages among the verified lines.

damaged.description: True when the file holds bytes after its verified prefix: a torn final line, or a line that breaks the chain. The seal never refuses the ending commit (F13a).

verified_bytes.description: When damaged: the length of the verified prefix.

undeliverable.description: Lead messages that never reached the worker: never posted, never delivered and never replied to (D-13, D-14).

unseen_by_lead.description: Worker messages no Lead generation was shown (D-38).
